title: 第二十二章 道侣第二十三章局势
slug: 魔头别夺舍了我们正道快没人了
lines: 终究，季南北还是没能阻止系统出来“添乱”。
【已触发任务，请从以下选项中择一执行。】
选项一、任百合绽放，让气氛变得微妙起来!与师妹“亲密互动”。（奖励:魔道点五十万，六品功法《大日金身法》。）
选项二、去，给她两巴掌，让她清醒清醒!以掌力唤醒师妹。（奖励:魔道点三十万，五品功法《女彤大法》。）
选项三、耐心引导，百合之路并非如此简单。以灵气刺激唤醒师妹，并告知:你是个好人。（奖励:魔道点一万，三品毒药化骨散。）季南北只能感叹，这系统真是唯恐天下不乱。
好家伙，眼下这情形，真选第一个去“亲密互动”?
萧京溪非当场崩溃不可。
他轻叹一声，再次以灵气渡入，尝试唤醒白洁。
这回他刻意拉开了距离，隔空渡入灵气，免得又如刚才那般，人刚醒又晕厥过去。
几番周折，总算将白洁成功唤醒。
季南北警惕地望着这位不太寻常的少女。
总觉得不放心，又往后退了半步。
醒转过来的白洁似乎也意识到自己先前举止过火，此刻跪坐在地，倒显得规矩了不少。嗯，至少态度是诚恳的。
“给师姐添麻烦了，我刚才实在太激动，一时没能控制住......”
季南北摆了摆手。
“无妨，只是此类事情，往后切莫再发生。”
“嗯嗯，一定一定。”
白洁忙不迭地应声。
此时，季南北偏了偏头。
“你方才说，心仪于我?想同我结为道侣?”
未等白洁回应，萧京溪先坐不住了。
这种事她着实承受不来!
季南北只是用右手轻拍左手手背，以只有两人能意会的方式，安抚了一下萧京溪。
白洁闻听此言，立刻抬起头，眼中再度亮起光芒。
“停!先回答问题。别忘了你方才应承的，不可再情绪失控。”
季南北见她又要陷入那种奇怪状态，急忙打断施法。
这才让白洁眼中的光亮敛去几分。
她规规矩矩跪坐着答道:
“对!我极为仰慕师姐，自上届九门夺魁，师姐赢得‘小剑仙’称号那一战起，便一直心仪师姐。见到师姐的身影，心跳总会不由自主地加快......”
九门夺魁正是前次修真界大比的名称。
因最终决战仅剩三宗六门的弟子，其余门派尽数淘汰，故得此名。前文提过，修真界的大宗大派共有四宗九派，至于哪些遭淘汰、哪些晋了级，此处便不赘述。
待后续剧情涉及相关比试时，再行细述。
听罢白洁的话，季南北摇了摇头。
“你也说了，是‘仰慕’于我。那你可曾细想过，何为‘喜欢’，结为道侣又意味着什么?”
白洁怔了怔。
这些她还真未曾深思。
她只觉得自己喜欢萧京溪，既然喜欢，那便去追求呗!
季南北一看她那神情，心中已有判断。
这孩子分明是青春悸动，头脑发热。虽说情感真挚，却经不起仔细推敲。

After all, Ji Nanbei still failed to prevent the system from "causing chaos".
[The task has been triggered, please choose one of the following options to execute. 】
Option 1. Let Lily bloom and make the atmosphere more subtle! "Intimate interaction" with junior sister. (Reward: 500,000 magic points, sixth-grade skill "Great Sun Golden Body Technique".)
Option 2: Go and give her two slaps to wake her up! Use the power of your palms to wake up the junior sister. (Reward: 300,000 magic points, fifth-level skill "Nvtong Dafa".)
Option 3: Patient guidance, the road to Lily is not that simple. Use spiritual energy stimulation to awaken the junior sister and tell her: You are a good person. (Reward: 10,000 magic points, third-grade poison into bone powder.) Ji Nanbei could only sigh, this system is really afraid that the world will not be in chaos.
Good guy, in this situation, do you really choose to be the first one to have "intimate interaction"?
Xiao Jingxi had to collapse on the spot.
He sighed softly and used his spiritual energy again to try to wake up Bai Jie.
This time, he deliberately distanced himself and entered the spiritual energy through the air, so as not to faint again as he had just woken up.
After several twists and turns, Bai Jie was finally awakened successfully.
Ji Nanbei looked at this unusual girl warily.
Feeling uneasy, I took another half step back.
Bai Jie, who woke up, seemed to realize that she had gone too far before, and now she was kneeling on the ground, looking much more behaved. Well, at least the attitude is sincere.
"I'm causing trouble to Senior Sister. I was so excited just now that I couldn't control it..."
Ji Nanbei waved his hand.
"It's okay, it's just that this kind of thing must not happen again in the future."
"Yeah, definitely."
Bai Jie responded hurriedly.
At this time, Ji Nanbei tilted his head.
"You just said that you like me? Do you want to become a Taoist couple with me?"
"Hey!"
Before Bai Jie could respond, Xiao Jingxi couldn't sit still.
She really can't bear this kind of thing!
Ji Nanbei just patted the back of his left hand with his right hand, comforting Xiao Jingxi in a way that only the two of them could understand.
Hearing this, Bai Jie immediately raised her head, her eyes lighting up again.
"Stop! Answer the question first. Don't forget what you just promised, and don't lose control of your emotions anymore."
Seeing that she was about to fall into that strange state again, Ji Nanbei hurriedly interrupted the spell casting.
Only then did the light in Bai Jie's eyes dim a bit.
She sat down on her knees and replied:
"Yes! I admire senior sister very much. Ever since the last time when she won the title of 'Little Sword Immortal' when the Nine Gates won the championship, I have always been in love with senior sister. When I see senior sister's figure, my heartbeat will always speed up involuntarily..."
The title of Nine Sects is exactly the name of the previous competition in the world of cultivation.
Because in the final battle, only three sects and six disciples were left, and all the other sects were eliminated, hence the name. As mentioned before, there are four major sects and nine sects in the world of cultivation. As for which ones have been eliminated and which ones have been promoted, I will not go into details here.
When the subsequent plot involves related competitions, we will elaborate on it later.
After listening to Bai Jie's words, Ji Nanbei shook his head.
"You also said that you 'admire' me. Then have you ever thought about what 'like' means and what it means to be a Taoist couple?"
Bai Jie was startled.
She hadn't really thought about this before.
She only thinks that she likes Xiao Jingxi. Since she likes him, she should pursue him!
When Ji Nanbei saw her expression, he already made a decision in his heart.
This child is clearly youthful and has a hot head. Although the emotion is sincere, it cannot withstand careful scrutiny.
